title: How the Walking Liberty Design Returned on the Silver Eagle
description: Follow the Walking Liberty design from its 1916 half dollar debut, through the Franklin change in 1948, to its return on the Silver Eagle in 1986.
ogDescription: The Walking Liberty design moved from a circulating half dollar to the Silver Eagle.
alt: Walking Liberty on two silver coins
ctaLine: Explore more stories from American coin history.
